title_en: Why Everyone Should Learn to Cook
description_ru: Короткое эссе о том, что кулинария должна быть школьным предметом, и о пользе домашней еды.
text:
Last month, my friend Victor admitted that at the age of thirty he had never cooked a real meal. He lives on sandwiches, frozen pizza and takeaway food. When I heard this, I realised that schools have missed something important. In my opinion, cooking should be a normal school subject, just like maths or geography.

The first benefit is health. People who cook at home usually eat more vegetables and less sugar, because they know exactly what is in their food. A ready meal from a shop often contains much more salt than we would ever add ourselves.

The second benefit is money. Although some ingredients look expensive, a simple pot of soup costs far less than a lunch in a restaurant. If Victor had learned to cook ten years ago, he would have saved a small fortune by now.

Finally, cooking is a wonderful skill for life. It teaches patience, planning and creativity. It is also a very friendly activity. When you invite people for dinner, you give them more than food. You give them your time and your attention.

Some people say they are too busy to cook. I understand, but a good meal does not have to take hours. Pasta with tomatoes, an omelette or a vegetable curry can be ready in twenty minutes.

So if you have never tried, why not begin this week? Buy fresh vegetables, find a simple recipe, and enjoy the smell of your own kitchen. I promise you will be proud of the result.
